base_member_text: Assumes exactly 13 stations in station.txt (the constant 14 at L55); not verifiable here.
audit_member_text: The selected mapping requires station rows 13,10,7,4,2,1 (L52-L56), but the loaded table is never checked to contain at least 13 rows or valid integer i/j indices within the 800-by-660 grids.

base_member_text: Label position again uses the row-index offset Y(sta_j(k)-15,sta_i(k)) (L58), failing if sta_j(k)<=15.
audit_member_text: The copied label offset Y(sta_j(k)-15,sta_i(k)) at L58 can index zero or below whenever a selected station has sta_j<=15; no bounds check exists.

base_member_text: The double relabeling — station-table row k=14-file_sta(kk) (L55) but display label G<kk> (L57) — means G1..G6 on this figure do not correspond to the G-numbers in the sibling plot_bathy_stations.m (which labels G<14-k>); the mapping between displayed labels and physical FRF gauges is not documented in the file.
Stale comments at L40-L45 ('make up breaker and foam', 'eta without breaker') are copied from the movie script and do not describe this code.

audit_member_text: The dep read assumes exactly m*n singles and does not check fopen/fread success (L16-L19).
